compute_bond_orientational_order: compute the bond-orientational order for each node in a graph using spherical harmonics and a neighbor mask
map_node_features_to_edges: map sender and receiver node features to edge features using a neighbor list for graph message passing
compute_legendre_polynomials: compute Legendre polynomials up to a given lmax for a tensor of values using standard recursion
build_compact_frequency_vectors: build a compact representation of frequency vectors from edge direction vectors and repeating dimensions for spherical harmonics
create_attention_mask_for_graph: create an attention mask and angle embedding for graph attention using edge directions and neighbor masks
